name: Beanie - Obliter8
description:
Stay warm while keeping the fit clean with the OBLITER8 Beanie. Featuring a classic black knit design and a bold front iron-on fabric patch logo, this piece delivers everyday comfort with standout detail.

The soft stretch material provides a comfortable fit, while the fold-over cuff keeps the look timeless and easy to style. Finished with the signature OBLITER8 planet graphic, this beanie is made for daily wear on and off the move.

Features:
• Soft stretch knit construction
• Fold-over cuff fit
• Iron-on fabric patch
• Classic black colorway
• One size fits most
